name: Reservation Criteria 7
definition: Defines the criteria to extract the reservation information and the expected reservation report. A name may be given to the new query.

NewQueryName.name: New Query Name
NewQueryName.definition: Name of the query defined by the search criteria and return criteria.

SearchCriteria.name: Search Criteria
SearchCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria to extract the reservation information.

ReturnCriteriaAndOrSearchCriteriaRule.definition: If ReturnCriteria is not present, then at least one occurrence of SearchCriteria must be present. If ReturnCriteria is present, then any occurrence of SearchCriteria is optional.
